=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:575 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: validate.yml defaults Semble bootstrap to true instead of the repo-wide opt-in false.
  WHY: This enables Semble for repos that never opted in, and reviewers split between high and critical severity so the consensus uses critical.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:552-611 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Install semble step can mark Semble available even when the install actually failed.
  WHY: The workflow relies on `bash scripts/install_semble.sh` as a failure signal, but the script writes its own env state and exits 0, so the dead branch can overwrite failure as success.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:155-166 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `main()` always returns 0 even on install failure.
  WHY: Callers cannot detect failure from the exit code, so workflow wrappers that gate on `if ! bash scripts/install_semble.sh` see every run as success.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:169-185 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: CI does not run the Semble workflow contract tests for validate, implement, or workflow parity.
  WHY: Semble wiring regressions can land without any CI signal.
- tests/test_validate_semble_contract.py:33-42 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The contract test asserts the true default for VALIDATION_USE_SEMBLE.
  WHY: It encodes the inconsistent behavior and blocks fixing validate.yml without updating the test.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:582-605 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: validate.yml pins astral-sh/setup-uv@v7 while the other workflows pin @v3.
  WHY: validate is the only workflow on a different major version, so behavior can diverge from the rest of the pipeline.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:649-704 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The BM25 index builder imports Semble modules after the pip install without guarding against partial installs.
  WHY: An ImportError or ModuleNotFoundError can break indexing even though the step is meant to fail open.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:425-461, 568-789 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The BM25 index build assumes the Semble Python modules import cleanly after the CLI install.
  WHY: A partial or dependency-conflicted install can raise ImportError and leave indexing broken.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:377-379 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: append_validate_semble_context ignores a failed `semble_query_block` call.
  WHY: The caller gets no warning or propagation when Semble context is dropped.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2914-2944 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: append_validate_semble_context ignores a failed `semble_query_block` call.
  WHY: Failed or empty Semble queries are silently dropped, so the caller cannot tell the context block was omitted.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:552-611 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Build semble index step only checks SEMBLE_AVAILABLE and never re-checks `command -v semble`.
  WHY: A failed or partial install can skip indexing silently without an explicit warning.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:127-136 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The fallback pip install adds `--break-system-packages`, which older pip versions do not understand.
  WHY: On runners with older pip, the second install attempt fails on argument parsing instead of acting as a fallback.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:57-65 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The Semble replacement path trims trailing whitespace and can glue the inserted block to the next line.
  WHY: Semble blocks rely on the template's separation, so rstrip changes the rendered prompt layout.
- scripts/semble_helpers.sh:146-163 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The timeout path assumes GNU timeout semantics.
  WHY: Cross-platform behavior differs and the timeout branch loses stderr detail on non-GNU implementations.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1929-2027 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The inline Python heredoc uses tab indentation inconsistent with the surrounding shell style.
  WHY: It is only a style issue, but it can trip tooling that normalizes indentation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: A failed Semble install gets overwritten as available, so downstream steps proceed against a missing binary.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:575 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: VALIDATION_USE_SEMBLE defaults to true instead of the repo-wide false opt-in.
  WHY: validate enables Semble for repos that never opted in, unlike the other workflows.
- tests/test_validate_semble_contract.py:40 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test asserts the true default for VALIDATION_USE_SEMBLE.
  WHY: It codifies the inconsistent behavior and blocks fixing validate.yml without updating the test.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:169-185 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: CI does not run tests/test_validate_semble_contract.py, tests/test_implement_semble_contract.py, or tests/test_semble_workflow_parity_contract.py.
  WHY: Semble workflow wiring regressions can land without any CI failure.
- .github/workflows/validate.yml:605 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: validate.yml pins setup-uv@v7 while the other workflows pin @v3.
  WHY: validate can behave differently from the rest of the pipeline because it is the only workflow on a different major version.
- scripts/install_semble.sh:127-136 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback pip install adds `--break-system-packages`, which older pip versions do not understand.
  WHY: On runners with older pip, the second install attempt fails for argument parsing instead of acting as a fallback.
